findings.failure_path: containment accepts a packet whose candidate sits anywhere as a contiguous run, so an author can prepend a sanitized decoy diff labeled as the candidate (or append a "superseding" decoy) while the real base-derived candidate is present but mislabeled as context; the check passes, both chain rounds bind it, the binder recomputes and accepts the candidate, and bytes land that no reviewer evaluated as the landing diff — the contract's append-only rule is documented but unenforced and no offset/length is disclosed to the reviewer
findings.smallest_fix: refuse unless the packet starts with the candidate (packet.startswith(candidate), which keeps all new fixtures green) and record the candidate's byte length in the receipt so the reviewer can locate the boundary

concern_results.conclusion: Containment is order- and label-insensitive: `candidate not in packet` accepts packets where arbitrary bytes precede the candidate or a second decoy diff follows it, and neither receipt nor packet discloses which byte run is the landing candidate, so the documented "context sits on top, appended after" rule is stated but not enforced — a prefix decoy labeled as the candidate with the real candidate riding along as "context" passes containment, binds both chain rounds (candidate-to-candidate comparison permits this), and is accepted by the binder. Verified the related guards hold: empty-candidate refusal precedes the substring check, --paths without --base is refused, the wording-only refusal fires for the new with-base combination (the no-base --diff-file+proof shape is pre-existing and still binds no landing), the chain relaxations admit only the intended widened shape since prior diff-file-only receipts already had packet==candidate, and candidate_paths correctly derive from the candidate, not the packet.

The merge-side invariant survives: the binder recomputes the candidate from the repository and the cross-side test discriminates (packet-hash mutation reds it alone), so unreviewed bytes cannot land via hash aliasing. The residual high-risk gap is the composition-order gap above: a landing-binding receipt can now be produced over a packet whose reviewer cannot mechanically tell candidate from context, weakening what the removed equality bought — reported as the finding below.

challenge_focus: Attack the containment invariant and what the removed equality used to buy. Can a packet contain the base-derived candidate verbatim as a contiguous byte run while the reviewer still fails to see part of what lands -- content appended BEFORE the candidate, a second copy of it, or context that visually resupplies a deleted hunk? The chain now compares candidate to candidate rather than packet to packet: construct a round sequence this permits whose combined evidence misrepresents what any single reviewer saw. Inspect the relaxations in _validate_chain_succession and the in-chain prior-receipt checks for a receipt shape that is now accepted and should not be. Can candidate_paths taken from the candidate under-select an owner? Look for a bypass in the empty-candidate guard, in --paths without --base, and in the wording-only refusal.
